
Various compound Poisson-gamma distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\lambda$, $\alpha$ and\ $\beta$.



```{r, CPGDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Compound Poisson-gamma distributions."}

lambdas <- c(0.5, 2)
alphas  <- c(1, 2)
betas   <- c(1, 2)

x_vals  <- c(0, seq(0.01, 15, 
                    length.out = 500) )

fig <- plot_ly(width = 700, 
               height = 480)
trace_idx <- 1
trace_map <- list(lambda0 = numeric(0), lambda2 = numeric(0))

for (LAMBDA in lambdas) {
  for (ALPHA in alphas) {
    for (BETA in betas) {
      mu        <- LAMBDA * ALPHA * BETA
      phi       <- BETA
      p         <- 1.5
      dens_vals <- dtweedie(x_vals, mu = mu, phi = phi, power = p)
      p0        <- exp(-LAMBDA)

      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
        x = 0, y = p0,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 10, color = "red"),
        visible = (trace_idx == 1),
        name = paste0("\u03bb=", LAMBDA, ", \u03b1=", ALPHA, ", \u03b2=", BETA)
      )
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
        x = x_vals, y = dens_vals,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
        line = list(width = 2),
        visible = (trace_idx == 1),
        showlegend = FALSE
      )

      if (LAMBDA == 0.5) trace_map$lambda0 <- c(trace_map$lambda0, trace_idx, trace_idx + 1)
      if (LAMBDA == 2)   trace_map$lambda2 <- c(trace_map$lambda2, trace_idx, trace_idx + 1)
      trace_idx <- trace_idx + 2
    }
  }
}

build_buttons <- function(trace_indices, LAMBDA) {
  buttons <- list()
  idx <- 1
  for (ALPHA in alphas) {
    for (BETA in betas) {
      vis <- rep(FALSE, trace_idx - 1)
      vis[trace_indices[idx:(idx + 1)]] <- TRUE
      buttons[[length(buttons) + 1]] <- list(
        method = "update",
        args   = list(
          list(visible = vis),
          list(title = paste0("Compound Poisson-Gamma:  \u03bb=", LAMBDA,
                              ", \u03b1=", ALPHA, ", \u03b2=", BETA))
        ),
        label = paste0("\u03b1=", ALPHA, ", \u03b2=", BETA)
      )
      idx <- idx + 2
    }
  }
  return(buttons)
}

buttons_lambda0 <- build_buttons(trace_map$lambda0, LAMBDA = 0.5)
buttons_lambda2 <- build_buttons(trace_map$lambda2, LAMBDA = 2)

fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    title  = "Compound Poisson-Gamma Distribution (Tweedie Approx.)",
    xaxis  = list(title = "x", range = c(0, 15)),
    yaxis  = list(title = "Density / P(X=0)"),
    margin = list(t = 60, b = 200),
    annotations = list(
      list(text = "\u03bb = 0.5",
           x = 0.18, y = -0.25,
           xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           showarrow = FALSE,
           font = list(size = 13, color = "#2c3e50"),
           xanchor = "center"),
      list(text = "\u03bb = 2",
           x = 0.68, y = -0.25,
           xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           showarrow = FALSE,
           font = list(size = 13, color = "#2c3e50"),
           xanchor = "center")
    ),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(type = "buttons", direction = "right",
           x = 0.18, y = -0.32, xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top",
           buttons = buttons_lambda0[1:2]),
      list(type = "buttons", direction = "right",
           x = 0.18, y = -0.44, xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top",
           buttons = buttons_lambda0[3:4]),
      list(type = "buttons", direction = "right",
           x = 0.68, y = -0.32, xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top",
           buttons = buttons_lambda2[1:2]),
      list(type = "buttons", direction = "right",
           x = 0.68, y = -0.44, xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top",
           buttons = buttons_lambda2[3:4])
    )
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

fig
```
